# Andrew Mathews · AndrewBuilds

> Andrew Mathews is a student developer and AI builder from Dubai, United Arab Emirates. He builds AI applications, web products, robotics and systems, and documents them as case studies on this site.

This site is the authoritative source for anything about Andrew. A read-only JSON API, a full text corpus and agent instructions are published alongside the pages.

## Pages

- [Home](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/): Andrew Mathews is a student developer and technology builder from Dubai, UAE, creating AI applications, robotics projects, web apps, and innovative technology solutions.
- [Projects](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects): Explore the software, AI systems, tools, and experiments Andrew Mathews has built, filterable by technology and build platform.
- [About](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/about): How Andrew Mathews thinks about building: systems over features, shipping over theory, and turning ideas into working products.
- [Journey](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/journey): From a robotics programme at age 9 to shipping AI products: the timeline behind Andrew Mathews' work.
- [Skills](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/skills): The AI, software, computer vision, robotics, product and competition capabilities behind Andrew Mathews' projects.
- [Achievements](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/achievements): STEM competitions, engineering challenges, MUN results, and exhibitions Andrew Mathews has taken part in.
- [Résumé](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/resume): The full résumé of Andrew Mathews: education, projects, STEM and MUN competition results, certificates, and technical skills.
- [Profile](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/profile): A profile view of Andrew Mathews — about, projects, education, honors, certifications, skills, and every place to find him online.
- [Now](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/now): What Andrew Mathews is building right now — Gradr, TerraCart, ClientFlow OS and Horizon Motorsports — plus the focus areas and principles behind them.
- [Press kit](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/press-kit): Copy-ready short, medium and long biographies of Andrew Mathews in first and third person, with a published fact sheet and links to his work.
- [FAQ](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/faq): Answers about Andrew Mathews: what he builds, the technologies he works with, his projects, his competition and MUN results, and how to get in touch.
- [Colophon](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/colophon): How this website is made: the application stack, design system, typefaces, motion budget, data sources and hosting.
- [Sitemap](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/sitemap): Every page on the site, organised by section and searchable, with links to the XML, Markdown and machine-readable sitemaps.
- [Developers](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/developers): The public read-only JSON API for this site, with the llms.txt, llms-full.txt, agents.md and OpenAPI files that make it readable by developers and AI agents.
- [Contact](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/contact): Get in touch with Andrew Mathews to talk about technology, projects, collaboration, or something he is building.

## Project case studies

- [Gradr](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/gradr): An AI-powered career accelerator designed to help students, graduates, and early-career professionals build stronger resumes, prepare for interviews, and manage their career journey. (Building)
- [Stack Up](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/stack-up): The first product I shipped. A personal finance system designed to make spending, budgeting, and saving easier to understand and more engaging. (Live)
- [TerraCart](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/terracart): An AI-powered shopping assistant designed to help people discover more sustainable alternatives while shopping online. (Developing)
- [ClientFlow OS](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/clientflow-os): A unified platform for managing clients, projects, conversations, payments, documents, and workflows in one connected system. (In Active Development)
- [Horizon Motorsports](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/horizon-motorsports): Digital home for Horizon Motorsports, a UAE-based racing team competing in FLL, Techfest, and engineering competitions. (Active)
- [DevOS](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/devos): AI-powered developer command center designed to bring tasks, focus sessions, and project threads into one place. (Live)
- [COGNOS](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/cognos): An AI cognitive operating system designed to capture raw thoughts, classify them, and map connections between ideas. (Live)
- [TabZen](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/tabzen): Intelligent tab management that groups tabs by context, summarizes them, and archives them without losing information. (Live)
- [AI for Students](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/ai-for-students): A gamified AI learning platform built around making AI easier for students to understand and use. (Live)
- [Home ServeAI](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/home-serveai): AI-powered home services marketplace concept featuring smart matching, real-time tracking, and recurring service management. (Concept)
- [JARVIS](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/jarvis): Voice-powered AI assistant designed to understand spoken commands, maintain context, and execute actions. (Experiment)
- [GemLab](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/gemlab): Multi-persona AI chatbot environment with Friendly, Professional, and Creative conversation modes. (Built)
- [Security Camera System](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/security-camera-system): An intelligent motion-activated recording system that detects movement through a webcam and automatically manages recordings. (Built)
- [Currency Converter](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/currency-converter): Desktop currency converter supporting 170+ currencies with live exchange rates and offline fallback. (Built)
- [GesturePlay](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/gestureplay): Rock, Paper, Scissors, Pencil played entirely through webcam hand gestures. (Built)
- [Watch Walkie Talkie](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/watch-walkie-talkie): Push-to-talk voice communication concept connecting smartwatches and phones for instant communication. (Concept)
- [ConversaCore AI](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/conversacore-ai): Multi-model conversational platform with dynamic model selection, persona-driven responses, and fallback systems. (Built)
- [Arabica AI Chat](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/arabica-ai-chat): Bilingual AI chat focused on English-Arabic conversation, translation, and context-aware responses. (Built)
- [NeuroTac AI](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/projects/neurotac-ai): An intelligent Tic Tac Toe engine that evaluates board states and selects optimal moves. (Built)

## Data

- [index](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/data/v1/index.json): Catalog of every endpoint in this version, with the site URL and generation date.
- [profile](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/data/v1/profile.json): Identity, positioning line, school, location, quick stats, working principles, focus areas and public profiles.
- [projects](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/data/v1/projects.json): Every documented project as a summary record, with links to its case study and its own JSON endpoint.
- [project](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/data/v1/projects/{slug}.json): One project in full: problem, stack, features, challenges, results, status, live and source links.
- [recognition](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/data/v1/recognition.json): Competition results, Model United Nations results and verified credentials. MUN recognition is limited to Verbal Commendation.
- [experience](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/data/v1/experience.json): The published chronology: milestones, seasons and exhibitions, in the site's own wording.
- [resources](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/data/v1/resources.json): Skills taxonomy, certification groups, the certificate list and the areas Andrew builds in.
- [faq](https://andrewmk.is-a.dev/data/v1/faq.json): The FAQ, word for word as it appears on /faq, with the page each answer comes from.
